notes: A CLEARER LOOK ON EVERY SCREEN. The whole app has been redrawn to one standard: one type style, stronger contrast, clear card edges, and figures that are never cut off. The dashboard leads with cash, income and expenditure, then what needs you. Wide registers (Staff Advances, Withholding Payables, Petty Cash) now fit the page, with one main button per row. Settings shows one group at a time, with a Find a setting box. Large photos are reduced as you attach them, and Backup shows the space your attached papers take. Carries everything in 0.8.145. Installing: no migration and no change to your data. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
